title: SessionTokenContract
description: The session token routes: POST /api/v1/auth/refresh rotates a refresh token into a new pair, and POST /api/v1/auth/logout revokes the session (204). The root is the pair.

SessionTokenPair.description: POST /api/v1/auth/refresh answer: a new access token, its expiry, and the successor refresh token. The presented refresh token is spent; presenting it again revokes the whole token family.

SessionTokenRequest.description: POST /api/v1/auth/refresh and POST /api/v1/auth/logout body. An empty or absent refresh_token answers 400.
